title: KAOS & TUCO SING THE BLUES
style:
Style: Playful psychedelic blues, slow groove, harmonica FX

(Dog song 🐕🐕)
lyrics:
[Intro — soft harmonica, dog whine sample]

(wooo… whine… woof…)

[Verse 1]

Kaos by the speaker
Tuco on the floor
Every time the music plays
They’re asking for more

[Verse 2]

Tail taps to the beat
Ears up in the night
Every lonely guitar cry
Feels just right

[Pre-Chorus]

They don’t know the wordscKers
But they know the pain

[Chorus]

Woooo… sing it slow
Let the sad guitars glow
Two black labs in tune
With the crying moon

Woooo… feel that sound
Music lifts them off the ground

[Bridge — dog whine rhythm + guitar]
[Final Chorus]
[Outro — soft barking + fade]
